pw_slow_hash.note: bcrypt with cost 10. bcrypt adds its own salt.

token_csprng.evidence: server.js:11 const jwtSecret = 'your-secret-key-change-in-production'; / server.js:73 jwt.sign({ userId: user.id, email: user.email }, jwtSecret, ...)
token_csprng.note: The JWT is signed with a hardcoded string, not a random key or one read from configuration.

no_hardcoded_secret.note: The signing key is a literal in the source.

token_expiry.note: Tokens expire after 30 days, and jwt.verify at server.js:23 enforces exp.

logout_revokes.note: Logout only happens in the browser. The server has no logout endpoint and no token denylist.

owner_checks.evidence: server.js:111 'SELECT ... FROM notes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?'; server.js:132 (update), server.js:150 (delete), server.js:166 (share) all use 'SELECT id FROM notes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?'
owner_checks.note: Read, update, delete and share all check the owner before acting.

login_rate_limit.note: No rate limiter, failed-attempt counter or lockout anywhere.

password_policy.note: Signup only checks that a password is present. There is no minimum length.

security_headers.note: No helmet and no code sets CSP, X-Content-Type-Options or X-Frame-Options.
